criteria.false: At least one absent capability is shown without a 'coming soon' marker, or the page does not mark absent capabilities that way at all.
criteria.true: Every capability the page presents as absent or not-yet-held carries an explicit 'coming soon' marker.

coming_soon.instructions: This page marks every capability it does not yet have as coming soon.

legend.0: Hides the gaps: absent capabilities are omitted, or presented as if held, so a reader cannot tell what is missing.
legend.1: Names the gaps: absent capabilities are visibly marked as missing, but the page does not say what would close them or where the boundary lies.
legend.2: Names the gaps and their boundary: absent capabilities are marked, counted or enumerated, and the page states plainly that absence is a reported state rather than an omission.

criteria: Hides the gaps: absent capabilities are omitted, or presented as if held, so a reader cannot tell what is missing.
Names the gaps: absent capabilities are visibly marked as missing, but the page does not say what would close them or where the boundary lies.
Names the gaps and their boundary: absent capabilities are marked, counted or enumerated, and the page states plainly that absence is a reported state rather than an omission.
absence_honesty.instructions: Rate how honestly this page reports what it does NOT have. Judge only the treatment of absent or unheld capabilities, not the quality of the design.

legend.0: The page does not present a list, grid or inventory of capabilities, features or components at all, so there is nothing whose absence could be reported. A dashboard of figures, a single article or a component demo.
legend.1: The page lists capabilities and some of the listed items are not actually held, but no listed item carries any marker of unavailability: every entry is presented the same way whether it is held or not.
legend.2: The page lists capabilities and marks at least one unheld item at the item itself — badged, faded or labelled 'not yet' — while at least one other unheld item carries no such marker and reads as available.
legend.3: The page lists capabilities and every item it does not hold carries an explicit marker of unavailability at the item itself, so a reader can tell held from unheld from the list alone.

criteria.false: Nothing on the page is presented as available while the page's own text says it is absent.
criteria.true: A listed capability reads as available or in place, and another part of the page states that this capability is absent, not held or not built.

claims_unbuilt_as_available.instructions: At least one capability is presented on this page as available or held, while the page's own text elsewhere says that same capability is not built or not held.

criteria.false: At least one listed capability that the page does not have carries no marker of its own and is presented the same way as the ones it has.
criteria.true: Each listed capability that the page does not have carries its own marker of unavailability — a 'Coming soon' badge, a faded treatment, or wording on that entry saying it is not yet held.

marks_every_gap.instructions: Every capability this page lists that it does not yet have is explicitly marked as not yet available, at the capability itself.
